title: Intent Envelope Schema
description: The complete signed intent envelope. The outer envelope contains the cryptographic wrapper. The payload contains the intent. The intent never asserts its own validity — Nano verifies externally.

envelope_version.description: Version of the envelope format itself, separate from intent_schema_version

signature.description: Base64url-encoded signature over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the payload object

signing_key_id.description: Key ID Nano uses to look up the public key in the signer registry

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization scheme applied to payload before signing. Must be RFC8785_JCS.

intent_schema_version.description: Nano checks this first. If unsupported, reject before any crypto work.

session_id.description: Collision-resistant session identifier. Format: session_<date>_<scope>_<uuid4>. Anchors sequence_number to a specific model startup instance.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing per session_id. Used for deduplication and replay detection.

prior_intent_id.description: intent_id of the immediately preceding intent in this session for the same asset. Null if this is the first.

model_id.description: Must match an entry in the signer registry's authorized_models list for the signing key

calibration_profile.description: Named calibration profile active when this prediction was made. Used to invalidate intents if calibration is revoked.

generated_at.description: When the model produced this intent

expires_at.description: Payload request for expiry. Nano overrides if this exceeds action registry max_expiry_seconds.

confidence_method.description: Nano must never evaluate a confidence score without knowing how it was produced. Unsupported methods route to human review.

action_type.description: Must match a key in the action registry. Unknown action types are rejected.

autonomous_execution_requested.description: Payload request only. Action registry and Nano governance override this.

human_review_required.description: Payload request only. Action registry and Nano governance override this.

personnel_nearby.description: If true and action requires_zone_clearance, Nano blocks autonomous execution

safety_layer_required.description: If true and action requires_safety_layer and safety layer is unavailable, Nano blocks
